items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I was going with Jerome Pascal when I first joined my brother's band he was a saxophone player.

ctx.x: The way I went up and asked the engineer, can I shovel coal to Chicago and things like that. And I walked through that yard where they had the toughest railroad detectives in the world. Walked right on through and nobody didn't say nothing. And things like that.

I tell Zutty that every day or every other day. That education would have meant one thing in fact the thing that's hurt him. Now I was going with Jerome Pascal when I first joined my brother's band he was a saxophone player.
Well is that where he came from, St. Louis?
